source: Dummy face model candidate review seed for Dawson validation. The TroonTraits row is a product-pattern reference only, not a source-code or license approval.
notes: This library is metadata-only: no user images, measurements, account IDs, camera frames, face landmarks, or private notes.
Automatic side-profile numerical outputs remain blocked until Dawson approves a browser-local model, source/license terms, repeatability tests, and user-facing uncertainty copy.
The current prototype ships browser-local frontal MediaPipe landmarks and manual side-profile logs without image storage.

candidates.label: TroonTraits local face scan pattern
candidates.reviewStatus: needs source-code and license review before any implementation copy
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: Reference pattern says browser-local camera/photo flow; this seed does not approve copying source code or storing images.
privacyRequirements: Use only as a UX/product reference unless source and license are explicitly approved.
Keep camera/photo analysis local to the browser.
Do not store uploaded face photos or live camera frames with measurement records.
limitations: Public page text does not prove implementation details, model file, license, or measurement accuracy.
Observed public flow focuses on frontal scan behavior and midface ratio, not side-profile inference.
nextValidationSteps: Manually inspect source/license or get owner permission before copying any implementation detail.
Compare only product behavior: local camera/photo modes, privacy copy, and metric logging flow.
Decide whether this remains a reference only or becomes a licensed implementation target.

candidates.label: MediaPipe Face Landmarker frontal mesh
candidates.reviewStatus: implemented for frontal prototype; production measurement wording still needs review
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: Browser-local analysis; saved records keep derived metrics, source, note, timestamp, and landmark count but no image payload.
privacyRequirements: Keep image bytes out of saved records, backups, exports, share dashboards, and analytics.
Label all metrics as low/medium confidence because pose, lens, crop, lighting, and expression change ratios.
limitations: Frontal landmarks are not sufficient for sagittal nose, chin, jaw, or neck profile measurements.
The current metrics are repeatable relative logs, not diagnosis, identity inference, or attractiveness scoring.
nextValidationSteps: Run repeatability tests across lighting, lens distance, crop, and expression.
Review metric labels and uncertainty copy before public launch.
Keep side-profile claims out of the automatic model path.

candidates.label: Manual side-profile measurement log
candidates.reviewStatus: implemented as collection fallback; production copy needs review
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: No side-profile photo is stored; users enter manually annotated values or a note.
privacyRequirements: Do not persist side-profile image data.
Keep manual values account-scoped and exportable/deletable with the rest of local face logs.
Label entries as manual collection, not automatic model inference.
limitations: Manual values depend on the user's external annotation method.
No automatic repeatability guarantee exists until a licensed side-profile model is selected.
nextValidationSteps: Add optional calibration guidance if Dawson approves a manual annotation workflow.
Decide whether manual side-profile logging is enough for launch or needs a model search.
Review side-profile metric ranges and copy with the broader face evidence review.

candidates.label: Browser-local 3D face reconstruction
candidates.reviewStatus: needs model, license, bundle-size, and repeatability review
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: Candidate must run locally and discard frames/images after deriving review-approved metrics.
privacyRequirements: Must run in browser or native local runtime without uploading face images.
Must not emit identity embeddings or biometric templates.
Must document model license, bundle size, failure states, and deletion behavior.
limitations: Likely heavier than the current Face Landmarker path.
Depth metrics need calibration and pose normalization before they are useful logs.
nextValidationSteps: Review candidate model licenses for permissive commercial terms and browser-compatible runtimes.
Measure load time, memory, model size, and offline behavior.
Build a fixture set with repeated side-profile/photo captures before enabling outputs.

candidates.label: Profile-specific landmark detector
candidates.reviewStatus: needs licensed model search and validation review
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: Candidate must analyze images locally and save only derived side-profile metrics or note records.
privacyRequirements: No image upload, identity matching, or biometric template storage.
Keep outputs marked as side-profile model estimates with confidence and failure reasons.
Require explicit user action before saving metrics.
limitations: A profile-only detector may not solve calibration or scale without reference markers.
Model availability and license suitability are unknown.
nextValidationSteps: Search for commercially usable profile landmark models or datasets with explicit license review.
Test left/right profile mirroring, glasses/facial hair, and crop sensitivity.
Decide whether metric confidence is good enough to replace manual logs.

candidates.label: Hosted vision side-profile analysis
candidates.reviewStatus: needs explicit privacy, biometric, legal, and user-consent review
candidates.imageStoragePolicy: Not approved for launch; would require uploading face photos or derived image features to a provider.
privacyRequirements: Requires a separate photo/vision upload decision before any implementation.
Must not be enabled by default in the local-first prototype.
Requires provider retention, deletion, consent, and biometric-processing review.
limitations: Conflicts with the current local-first face measurement promise.
Adds high privacy and legal risk compared with local/manual workflows.
nextValidationSteps: Keep out of scope unless Dawson explicitly approves hosted face-photo processing.
If revisited, run privacy/legal review for consent, retention, deletion, and no-training policy before prototype work.
